text: Code reviews are a vital part of software development, where team members examine each other's code before it is finalised. This process helps catch bugs early, when they are much easier and cheaper to fix than in later stages. Beyond finding errors, code reviews promote knowledge sharing, as developers learn different techniques and approaches from their colleagues. This exchange helps spread expertise across the team, reducing reliance on any single person. Ultimately, regular code reviews improve overall team quality, encouraging consistent coding standards and more robust software. They build a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
